UPSSSC Lekhpal Result 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission (UPSSSC) has released the result for the recruitment of Lekhpal posts on the official website. This recruitment was released for 7994 posts. Applications for the UPSSSC Lekhpal Recruitment 2025 were accepted from 29 December 2025 to 28 January 2026. The online examination was held on 21 May 2026. Candidates who appeared for this examination can download their UPSSSC Lekhpal Result 2026 from the link given below..

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 29 December 2025
  • Last Date : 28 January 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 28 January 2026
  • Correction Last Date : 04 February 2026
  • Eligibility Result : 26 February 2026
  • Exam Date : 21 May 2026
  • Exam City Details : 11 May 2026
  • Admit Card Available : 16 May 2026
  • Answer Key : 22 May 2026
  • Revised Answer Key : 01 July 2026
  • Result : 11 September 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 25/-
  • SC, ST, Candidates : Rs. 25/-
  • PH Candidates: Rs. 25/-
  • Mains Exam Fees
  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 200/-
  • SC, ST, Candidates : Rs. 80/-
  • PH Candidates : 0/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
